name: membrane
description: Audit your Amazon Ads account on your own computer, then hand the work you find to Membrane. Connect Amazon through Membrane's auth proxy; your data stays local.

interface.shortDescription: Audit your Amazon Ads, then hand the work to Membrane
interface.longDescription: Membrane runs Amazon accounts for brands. This plugin lets you start on your own computer: connect your Amazon Ads account through Membrane's auth proxy, pull 60 days of campaign data into a local database, and get an audit of wasted spend, budget limits, unharvested search terms, and structure problems. Nothing leaves your computer except the sign-in. When the audit finds work, the report links to Membrane's Amazon Ads job and names the findings file to share, so you can hand the work over on membrane.agency.
defaultPrompt: What is wasting money in my Amazon ads?
